name: merge-duplicate-contacts
notion_automation: WIRED 2026-07-28. Notion DB automation on Contacts ("Duplicate of" edited) POSTs to trigger.webhook_url. The payload carries ONLY the page id — zero properties — so the workflow reads `Duplicate of` from a fresh page read; anything trusting the payload would conclude the relation is empty and silently do nothing. Notion does not expose automations via API, so re-wiring after any change to the catch URL is a manual step in the Notion UI.
description: Notion Contacts: Duplicate of set by a person -> merge the source into the target, but ONLY when identity is corroborated (equivalent names or the same LinkedIn profile, or — when names differ — a Jev same-person check; differing LinkedIn URLs are a hard decline). Fills empty target fields, ORs checkboxes, UNIONS every multi-value property, never copies the Duplicate of / Possible duplicate relations, and never deletes anything — the source is left in place with a comment saying what was copied. Replaces the Contact Merger Notion Custom Agent.

ai_model.provider: TypeSafe (api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone), via sdk.fetch on the typesafe connection (API by Zapier, Bearer)
ai_model.note: Added 2026-10-03 as a second opinion on the name-mismatch decline only: merge when Jev's same-person probability >= 0.85 AND evidence score >= 2/3. LinkedIn conflicts stay a hard decline Jev never sees; rule merges make no Jev call. Replayed the 6 real Duplicate-of requests: both real false declines (Ustaz Syakir, New Contact/Alasdair Bell) now merge; constructed negatives score <= 0.35. One Zapier task per Jev call plus ~$0.0001 TypeSafe usage. See README 'Second opinion from Jev'.
